end_to_end.expected: After 3 real hands, an error mid-hand 4 replaces the table with 'Something went wrong' + the D-1 sentence + one native Return Home button, no details; Return Home opens Home with '... 3 hands · paused'; IndexedDB holds exactly hands 1-3 and the same session record (handsPlayed 3) before and after; Resume deals Hand #4 with the stored stacks; a second error after Return Home is shown again; worker failure followed by Return Home gives one new worker and working hints/bots; a Session report mount failure shows the error screen; axe clean; same-origin only.
end_to_end.actual: All observed in both browsers. Illegal bot action in hand 4 -> error screen, focused heading, body innerText is exactly the three texts, no 'Injected'/'Error'/stack/file text, exactly 1 button (>= 44x44), Tab reaches BUTTON 'Return Home', axe zero serious/critical. Exactly one 'Unexpected error' console log even when a rejection and an uncaught error were raised while the screen showed. Enter -> TLH Trainer heading focused, history.state.tlhTable unset, subtitle '... 3 hands · paused'; hands store deep-equal to snapshot (handNumbers 1,2,3), sessions store deep-equal (handsPlayed 3). Resume -> 'Hand #4', seat stacks equal stored session seats. queueMicrotask throw during resumed hand 4 -> error screen again (2nd log), Return Home -> still 3 hands, stores unchanged. Browser Back from Home then leaves the app (no dead table). Worker 'error' in hand 3 -> error screen; Return Home -> worker count +1 immediately; Resume -> Hint shows 'Recommended: ...' (no failure text), hand 3 completes and is stored; a later ok:false reply -> error screen again, no further worker created. Report mount failure on Leave table -> error screen, no Session report heading, Return Home -> Home without Resume, report stored, New game -> Start game deals Hand #1 and bots act. All request URLs same-origin; dist/ contains no __tlhFault/__tlhWorkers marker.

findings.expected_vs_actual: Carried from J-1-02 and not a defect in this change: leaving the table during a hand stores that hand as a forced fold (existing behaviour). Whether a paused 0-hand session should be offered for Resume at all is a product question, and the locked spec section 5/7 still assume it is not.
